# Rebuild analytics-matomo on PHP 8.3
## Goal
The container on prod-matomo-01 runs PHP 8.3; `stats.northwind.example` answers 200 and tracks visits.
## Environment and targets
- Environment: production; host prod-matomo-01 (10.20.30.95); container `analytics-matomo`
- Repository `analytics/matomo`, Dockerfile `FROM matomo:4.16-php8.1`
## Change, step by step
### Step 1
- Backup: database dump (the backup plan matomo-db), image tag noted
- Change: `FROM matomo:5.1-php8.3-fpm`; CI builds and pushes the image
- Check: `docker exec analytics-matomo php -v` → 8.3.x
- Rollback: redeploy the previous image tag
fix.releaseNote: Argus never runs a production change. Hand this prompt to a person or an agent; the operator approves each step.

rows.label: What broke
rows.value: The Matomo container on `prod-matomo-01` runs PHP 8.1.2, end of life and exploitable (CVE-2026-24410, KEV).

rows.label: Why
rows.value: The image `matomo:4.16-php8.1` was pinned in 2024 and never rebuilt (proven).

rows.label: Impact
rows.value: `stats.northwind.example` is internet-facing; remote code execution through the PHP-CGI argument flaw.

rows.label: Fix
rows.value: Rebuild on `matomo:5.1-php8.3-fpm` and redeploy (Option 1) — the operator approves (production).
